sources.title: pocharlies/gb10-dgx-spark-llm-optimizations · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Optimized NVFP4 checkpoints and reproducible recipes for serving Qwen3.6-class models on NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark, sm_121, 119.6 GiB unified memory) with vLLM. Everything here was measured on real hardware — a 2-node GB10 cluster running production agentic workloads (tool-calling agents, coding CLIs, chat).

sources.title: GitHub - omnia-projetcs/spark-dgx
sources.snippet: Welcome to my repository and guide for running, optimizing, and benchmarking state-of-the-art AI models on the NVIDIA DGX Spark deskside supercomputer, powered by the cutting-edge NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip. This guide is designed to help researchers, developers, and data scientists get the maximum performance out of their local workstation when running LLMs, VLMs, and diffusion models.
